column1: # One untagged (65535) column's sample on a CCSID 1388 host, as Popsink/data-plane#5989 met it: a thousand clean CJK
# values and two damaged on the host itself, a stored SUB (0x3F) and a DBCS code 1388 does not map.
# The column decodes as text; the two damaged values carry U+001A and U+FFFD. Read by the tests of
# both backfill loaders (UntaggedCcsidTest.java, test_untagged.py); the connector's
# UntaggedColumnsTest pins this copy of Popsink/data-plane's docs/ibmi-untagged-sample.tsv.
# `decoded` is jt400's AS400Text in 1388, as a JSON string.
